product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system designed for physiotherapy clinics that blends traditional clinical management functions with Artificial Intelligence assistance to enhance patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes
Improve clinical documentation quality using AI
Increase operational efficiency and patient satisfaction
key_features: Comprehensive patient management with detailed medical records, interactive body map, and advanced search capabilities
Robust appointment system with calendar views, conflict prevention, recurring scheduling, and automatic notifications
Rich clinical documentation with SOAP notes editor, auto-save, customizable templates, and version control
AI assistant for automatic report generation, treatment protocol suggestions, risk analysis, clinical queries, and economic insights
Exercise library categorized by specialty with multimedia content, personalized prescriptions, and safety alerts
Secure patient portal for accessing personal data, prescribed exercises, appointment management, and communication with the clinic
Interactive dashboards and customizable reports covering operational, clinical, and financial metrics
Financial management including payments, revenue reports, delinquency tracking, and multiple payment integrations such as PIX
Inventory and material management with stock control, alerts, and transaction history
Task management system for activity creation, prioritization, progress tracking, and notifications
user_flow_summary: User authentication and role-based access control to tailor functionalities for Administrators, Physiotherapists, Interns, and Patients
Patient onboarding capturing personal info, medical history, photos, and interactive body map details
Scheduling appointments with conflict checks, recurring options, status updates, and notifications
Clinical documentation creation and editing using rich text editors, templates, versioning, and AI-generated reports
Exercise prescription via categorized library with multimedia, contraindications, and difficulty levels
Patient portal access for exercise tracking, viewing medical history, requesting appointments, and clinic communications
Financial transactions processing with integration to payment services and informed by analytics dashboards
Management of inventory, tasks, and events with alert systems to optimize clinic operations
validation_criteria: System supports user registration, profile editing, login sessions with automatic timeouts, and role-based access
Patient data entry validates CPF uniqueness and supports secure upload of photos and documents
Appointment system prevents scheduling conflicts, supports recurring appointments, sends notifications, and tracks appointment status
Clinical documentation includes rich text editing, auto-saving, version history, customizable templates, and AI-generated reports
AI assistant accurately generates physiotherapy reports, suggests treatment protocols, analyses dropout risks, responds to clinical queries, and provides economic insights
Exercise library categorization, multimedia management, personalized prescription, alerts for contraindications, and difficulty classification are functional
Patient portal provides secure login, displays prescribed exercises, medical histories, appointment scheduling, and communication channels
Reports and dashboards generate operational, financial, and clinical metrics with export options in PDF format
System performs page loads within 2 seconds, handles multiple simultaneous users, ensures 99.5% uptime, and processes AI queries within 10 seconds
Data encryption in transit and at rest is implemented, two-factor authentication is enabled, and logs of all changes and access are maintained for compliance with LGPD
